messages.subject: cutpoint
parts:
Paul,
I wasn't paying attention this AM and at first overlooked the attached document by
James Hickey. This is wonderful, and is opening up some doors. We can make the Cox
faster and simpler yet, based on some truths about trees and the logrank test that were
worked out 10+ years ago in the rpart code. It's an intersection of ideas that I should
have seen before, but now having it put in front of me you have provided a TADA moment.

I'll work this out yet today. Very exciting.

Terry T.
